description: This file contains core logic for applying patches to files, including classes, interfaces, and functions for computing and applying text replacements based on hunks, as well as processing patch hunks asynchronously.

classes.name: ApplyPatchError
classes.description: Custom error class for errors during patch application.

methods.name: applyChunksToContent
methods.description: Applies update chunks to original file content and returns the new content.

methods.name: processHunk
methods.description: Processes a single patch hunk and returns the corresponding file change.

methods.name: processAllHunks
methods.description: Processes multiple hunks and returns an array of file changes.
